report_name: Health Network and IT Firm to Pay $2.7M for Breach of 888,000 Patient Records

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exploited the trusted relationship between Boston Children's Health Physicians (BCHP) and its IT service provider, XTIUM. The compromise originated at XTIUM and was used as a launchpad to pivot into the networks of its clients, including BCHP.

identities.name: Boston Children's Health Physicians (BCHP)
identities.description: A pediatric health network that was a primary victim of a 2024 data breach. The breach originated from its IT service provider, XTIUM, and exposed the data of nearly 888,000 of its patients. BCHP was part of a $2.7 million settlement with New York and Connecticut.

identities.name: XTIUM
identities.description: A managed IT services provider for BCHP. A compromise of XTIUM's systems in August 2024 led to a supply chain attack affecting 18 of its clients, including BCHP, resulting in a major patient data breach and a subsequent $2.7 million settlement.
